## PI0276 executed native/DEV update — fixed data collection is running

Source/receipts: `907e4dd0`, reports/PI0276/execution/NATIVE_DEV_CURRENT_STATE.json. PI0274 terminal was separately published and read back as #6000835729 (execution complete; full qualification valid FAIL).

Both counted native fixtures PASS. DEV joint expert 8/8 and matched commanded-FK EEF replay 8/8 achieve the original native object predicate throughout 28–30 s. All four fixed always-open controls complete without sustained grasp or persistent stack success. No WBC or learned policy was called. TEST remains unopened.

Source owner PID 2599089 is genuinely running fixed TRAIN/VAL collection on corelab-4080s. The saved snapshot has 65 actual starts, 38,950 reserved control/RGB calls and 194,740 actual physics calls; the snapshot is a bounded observation, not a claim the full dataset is ready. Independent NumPy reconstruction over the then-completed 23 attempt records agrees with native saved predicates; full final source replay remains to be done.

Two engineering failures are preserved: minimal renderer exposes PositionSegmentation, not separate Position/Segmentation; native MPLIB 0.1.1 ArticulatedModel crashes under NumPy2 before any teacher control. The latter was reproduced without physics, then resolved under the upstream-confirmed NumPy1.26.4 ABI with the same planner/source/assets/gains. Same-condition technical replacements and all attempted calls remain counted. Native RGB conversion now uses the pinned minimal shader's actual uint8 transform. Measured opening uses the URDF pad inner-face calibration, distinct from command fraction.

New data/codec/Trainer adapters are implementation work, not PASS receipts. No canary or TASK8192 training has run yet. Positive source data, TRAIN-only task normalization, actual input/codec and exact-resume gates remain required; passing them automatically continues the already-authorized TASK8192 and physical evaluations. selected_checkpoint=NONE; deployment_selected_checkpoint=NONE. No PR77 pointer, monitor, mail, merge, seed replacement or second scientific arm.
